nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level index for the 2026-06-10 ORGII architecture audit, listing 30 top-level acceptance criteria across FSM/queue control flow, module boundaries, naming, wire protocol, init parity, panic/error handling, and UI/security, plus a Critical/High findings overview and links to all sub-reports.

nodes.name: be-audit.md
nodes.summary: Backend (Rust/Axum) architecture audit covering compilation correctness, dead code and duplicate definitions (orphaned coding_agent module, unregistered benchmark.rs commands, triplicate ApiError, cross-crate ProviderConfig collisions), naming consistency, semantic overloading, unsafe default branches, cross-domain leaks, wire protocol, init parity, and resolver symmetry.

nodes.name: cross-layer-audit-part2.md
nodes.summary: Second part of the cross-layer audit, sweeping for magic strings duplicated between frontend and backend, kebab-case vs snake_case IPC parameter mismatches, localStorage/sessionStorage vs SQLite inconsistencies, DEFAULT_PINNED list and skill ID verification, cross-layer memory-file checks, and a list of items flagged for deeper investigation.

nodes.name: cross-layer-audit.md
nodes.summary: Cross-layer audit of the Tauri IPC boundary between frontend and backend: a command-usage matrix for the top 20 commands, alignment of SessionStatus/AgentExecMode enums and event names, an init-parity matrix, a resolver fallback matrix, and a comparison of the SQLite schema against frontend column assumptions, including a stale ALTER TABLE artifact.

nodes.name: fe-audit.md
nodes.summary: Frontend (React/TypeScript) architecture audit covering compilation correctness, dead code and misplaced components (ChatPanel PanelViews, cross-engine imports), naming consistency, semantic overloading, default branches, cross-domain leaks, FE-side wire protocol usage, init parity at FE entry points, resolver symmetry, and a full codebase sweep table.

nodes.name: findings-detail.md
nodes.summary: Detailed catalog of every audit finding (8 Critical, 12 High, 8 Medium, plus Low/Info) including the UI bypassing the FSM via direct transport calls, an orphaned coding_agent module tree, a 4-way duplicated SessionStatus type, a data-loss bug from unwrap_or_default in lib.rs, and leftover diagnostic logging.

nodes.name: memory-verification.md
nodes.summary: Verifies the project's long-term 'memory' notes against the current codebase state across cross-layer, frontend, and backend concerns, flags an open bug where diagnostic logging is still active, and recommends a memory-file update checklist.

nodes.name: naming-collisions.md
nodes.summary: Glossary of naming collisions and semantically overloaded terms across the codebase, including Rust structs sharing the same name across modules, repeated TypeScript type names, cross-layer duplicate definitions, and heavily overloaded words such as 'session' (11 distinct meanings), 'agent', 'tab', 'mode', and 'pill'.

nodes.name: remediation-roadmap.md
nodes.summary: Phased remediation roadmap translating the audit findings into independent, parallelizable PRs: Phase 1 clears the 8 Critical findings, Phase 2 the 10 High findings, Phase 3 the Medium/Low findings, and Phase 4 covers long-tail Info items, with explicit out-of-scope items and acceptance thresholds per PR.
